reuse.why: Adds the option to the existing getMonthActionCategories selector that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one query; each action only forwards its flag, and a shared MonthActionArgs type replaces the repeated inline argument types.

placement.why: The change sits in the category selector in budget/actions.ts where the exclusion rules already live.

scope.why: Only the selector parameter, the forwarding in each action and one test.

maintainability.why: One real parameter on a documented selector, applied uniformly by all six actions.
